description: Unsigned transactions to close a gAIX short with gAIX the wallet brings (amount, or all: true): approve the gAIX, repay, take out the USDG it frees. No trade and no hook; a whole close reads no price, so it works on weekends and whatever the hook charges. Simulated from the wallet.

all.description: true closes or takes out everything

amount.description: gAIX to repay, as a decimal string

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: gaix_short_close_in_kind
title: Prepare: close a gAIX short in kind
